verdane-stacc:teamtailor:79674a5b-3c92-4.title: Operation & Sales Lead to STACC
verdane-stacc:teamtailor:79674a5b-3c92-4.description:
STACC is a fast-growing tech recruitment startup that help both talents and companies to find the perfect match. Our misson is to accelerate the career for techies and help companies develop digitally!
We want to grow our team with a driven and talented Operations & Sales Lead that has a genuine interest for tech and a constant desire for growth. At STACC, you get to map your own development and work with colleagues who are transparent, encouraging and want you to try new things. We value good communication highly and believe that success is always a team effort.
In order for you to thrive in our team we believe that you are humble, have a “just get things done” attitude, likes to be challenged and enjoy networking via LinkedIn, phone or other available channels. We value gender equality and diversity highly in our organization and therefore strive for a team that reflects the diversity of society. Does this sound like something for you? Let’s talk!
What are you going to do? 
Main responsibility will be around sales and relationship management
Establish our STACC Community and operationally lead our development program for tech talents
Commercial responsibly and lead all dialogues with companies
Drive new sales and build a network within Tech-Stockholm
Provide excellent services and communication to all stakeholders, both clients and tech talents within the community
Operationally plan and execute all activities and events within our development program
Skills & Qualifications 
Experience (or interest) in sales and building relationships
Great communication in close collaboration with teams
You stand out in your creativity; always seeking new ways to approach top tech companies and looking for the new hidden possibilities
You’re up to date and understand the real needs of tech companies and tech talents
You’re truly interested in the tech scene and speak their lingo
You’re open-minded and able to quickly build relationships with hiring managers
You speak Swedish and English at a fluent level
What do we offer you? 
A great deal of influence in the development of STACC
Being part of a team that work hard but also love to have fun together!
Office based in the heart of Stockholm (A house)
Access to A house activities such as wine tasting, yoga, events, AW and pop up- outlets
AW/Conferences/Teambuilding activities with STACC and Levels
Competitive salary benefits such as team-based quarterly bonus, pension and private medical insurance
Flexible work hours
And of course your birthdays off!
We look forward to your application!

xange-bigblue:lever:add40098-2961-4c3d-9.title: Sales Development Representative 🇫🇷
xange-bigblue:lever:add40098-2961-4c3d-9.description:
E-commerce is booming — but independent brands still struggle to match the seamless logistics of giants like Amazon. At Bigblue, we’re on a mission to change that.
We help brands by democratizing best-in-class operations: scaling faster while delivering a five-star customer experience.
 
Since 2018, we’ve built a tech-driven logistics platform powering 600+ brands — from fast-growing DTC players to global names like MUJI, Aigle, and Cabaïa. With 130+ employees across Paris, Madrid, and London, our proprietary WMS (Warehouse Management System) Atlas, and a network of 10 warehouses across Europe, we’re solving logistics challenges that others haven’t dared to tackle — making fulfillment faster, smarter, and greener.
 
Backed by $20+M in funding and trusted by the next generation of e-commerce leaders, we’re scaling rapidly — from 12 million orders in 2025 toward ambitious enterprise expansion. The journey ahead is bold, and we’re looking for the right partner to help us lead the way.
 
About the role 🚀
Your role will be crucial in identifying decision-makers (CEO, Logistic/Supply chains directors) and champions (E-commerce manager/Marketing Director) within target companies (e.g. Beauty & Cosmetics, Fashion & Accessories and Food supplements), establishing strong connections, and laying the foundation for high-level negotiations that will greatly facilitate and add value to the work of our Account Executives.
You will manage both outbound and inbound opportunities, engaging with prospects across multiple touchpoints and ensuring a seamless experience from the first interaction with Bigblue.
 
🧑‍💻 Market insight
Develop a strong understanding of the e-commerce ecosystem and key verticals we serve
Collaborate closely with the Growth, Marketing, and Partnerships teams to identify and research relevant sales targets within specific industries and customer segments
Share insights from prospect interactions to continuously refine our messaging, targeting, and go-to-market strategy
📥 Inbound lead qualification
Manage and qualify inbound leads generated through marketing, partnerships, and other channels
Engage quickly with prospects to understand their needs, logistics challenges, and growth ambitions
Identify high-potential opportunities and coordinate with Account Executives to ensure a smooth handoff
🌟 Outbound prospecting
Take charge of lead generation initiatives by designing and executing outbound prospecting campaigns
Leverage multiple communication channels (phone calls, email, LinkedIn, video messages, and other creative touchpoints) to engage prospects and generate new business opportunities
Craft personalized and relevant messaging to highlight Bigblue’s value proposition and capture the attention of key stakeholders
🕵️ Prospect engagement
Conduct thorough research to understand the personal interests and professional needs of your target prospects
Develop a deep understanding of prospect motivations, challenges, and buying behavior to tailor engagement strategies effectively
Maintain high-quality interactions that position Bigblue as a trusted partner
 
🎾 Relationship building
Build and nurture strong relationships with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor and resource
Organise or plan to attend events that your prospects will truly appreciate (tradeshows, restaurants, sports events, sports sessions, music shows, etc.)
Act as a brand evangelist, continuously promoting Bigblue's success stories and nurturing connections to create a favorable environment for future discussions

Your role will be crucial in identifying decision-makers (CEO, Logistic/Supply chains directors) and champions (E-commerce manager/Marketing Director) within target companies (e.g. Beauty & Cosmetics, Fashion & Accessories and Food supplements), establishing strong connections, and laying the foundation for high-level negotiations that will greatly facilitate and add value to the work of our Account Executives.

You will manage both outbound and inbound opportunities, engaging with prospects across multiple touchpoints and ensuring a seamless experience from the first interaction with Bigblue.

 
🧑‍💻 Market insight
  • Develop a strong understanding of the e-commerce ecosystem and key verticals we serve
  • Collaborate closely with the Growth, Marketing, and Partnerships teams to identify and research relevant sales targets within specific industries and customer segments
  • Share insights from prospect interactions to continuously refine our messaging, targeting, and go-to-market strategy

📥 Inbound lead qualification

  • Manage and qualify inbound leads generated through marketing, partnerships, and other channels
  • Engage quickly with prospects to understand their needs, logistics challenges, and growth ambitions
  • Identify high-potential opportunities and coordinate with Account Executives to ensure a smooth handoff

🌟 Outbound prospecting

  • Take charge of lead generation initiatives by designing and executing outbound prospecting campaigns
  • Leverage multiple communication channels (phone calls, email, LinkedIn, video messages, and other creative touchpoints) to engage prospects and generate new business opportunities
  • Craft personalized and relevant messaging to highlight Bigblue’s value proposition and capture the attention of key stakeholders
🕵️ Prospect engagement
  • Conduct thorough research to understand the personal interests and professional needs of your target prospects
  • Develop a deep understanding of prospect motivations, challenges, and buying behavior to tailor engagement strategies effectively
  • Maintain high-quality interactions that position Bigblue as a trusted partner
 
🎾 Relationship building
  • Build and nurture strong relationships with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor and resource
  • Organise or plan to attend events that your prospects will truly appreciate (tradeshows, restaurants, sports events, sports sessions, music shows, etc.)
  • Act as a brand evangelist, continuously promoting Bigblue's success stories and nurturing connections to create a favorable environment for future discussions
  • Sales experience in a high-growth software or SaaS environment targeting SMBs or mid-market companies
  • Native French speaker & professional level in English
  • Ability to identify, engage, and develop relationships with strategic partners
  • Motivated with a strong desire to learn and a strong work ethic
  • A top performer with a track record of exceeding targets as an individual contributor
  • Data-driven and process-oriented
  • 💼 High impact role: Be at the center of our growth journey and help shape the team that will power Bigblue’s future.
  • 💙 Founders-led company with an innovative, caring culture.
  • 🚀 Fast-growing scale-up: Join a well-funded, early-stage company where your work will have immediate and visible results.
  • 🌍 International environment: Work across Paris, Madrid, London, and our European warehouse network.
  • 🏢 Brand-new offices in the heart of Paris’ 9th arrondissement (biggest tech hub).
  • 🍱 10€ meal voucher per worked day (55% paid by Bigblue) + unlimited free snacks at the office.
  • 🧘‍♀️ ClassPass membership for fitness & wellness.
  • 🖥️ MacBook or any setup you need — your choice of equipment to do your best work.
  • 🩺 100% health insurance coverage with Benefiz.

    Regardless of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, origin, disability, age… At Bigblue, we create equal opportunities for all and make our culture as inclusive as possible. Because we believe that challenging assumptions and embracing diversity in experiences and backgrounds is what makes us stronger.
    Because what we value first and foremost are curiosity and growth-driven minds. So, regardless of who you are and how many “boxes” you tick on the job description, if you have the energy and passion to help shape Bigblue’s entrepreneurial adventure, APPLY.
